Royals Shut Out Angels 3-0 After Detmers' Strong Start

The Kansas City Royals defeated the Los Angeles Angels 3-0, with pitcher Noah Cameron throwing a one-hitter. Cameron pitched a complete game, striking out 11 batters and allowing only one hit. In the previous game, the Angels had won 1-0, with Reid Detmers pitching eight scoreless innings and Matt Schanuel driving in the game's only run in the eighth inning.
